items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Is that the one Where's the Waiter with the water for Madonna and all that stuff?

ctx.x: Well, they made Where's the Waiter? Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Is that the one Where's the Waiter with the water for Madonna and all that stuff? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Now I remember. It comes back.

And my Nara Ucha take a steamboat? Do you remember that? Maybe that one. Maybe that one. And the Land of the Yamo Yamo? I don't remember about that one. They're real funny. You know, they're all Wingy's job. You know how Wingy was. Yeah, yeah, yeah. That's what I mean.
